messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated tokens/request observed for tenant MeridianHealth in dedicated-pool-11. Alert link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/INC-1870004321 :rotating_light:

noah (eng-sre): Ack. I'm taking first responder. Can someone check whether this is isolated to Meridian or pool-wide?

paul (support): Meridian reported sudden billing preview jump at 16:03 UTC. Their integration is VPC/Dedicated. Quick metrics:
```
meridian: 15,600 tpm (baseline ~1,200)
pool-11: +4% overall
```
Sample payload 16:02:43 (from VPC proxy logs):
```
{"payload_hex":"feff004d006500720069006400690061006e...","content_type":"application/octet-stream"}
```
Tokenized -> ~95,200 tokens for that single request.

sara (eng-runtime): Leading bytes fe ff looks like UTF-16BE BOM. If their client switched encoding, tokenizer will split into lots of tiny tokens.

noah (eng-sre): Mitigation options: A) soft-request-level throttling for Meridian at 5 req/min + token soft cap 8k, B) immediate request rewrite at ingress to coerce UTF-16 -> UTF-8 (hotpatch), C) serve Meridian requests through a compact-model path with enforced max_context. Which is least customer-impacting?

omar (customer-ops): Customer wants no 500s. They prefer a transparent mitigation. Option C sounds safest short-term. They asked we avoid hard rejects.

sara (eng-runtime): I'll enable option C + minimal throttling. Hotpatch B is helpful but needs quick tests; we can stage it to canary.

noah (eng-sre): Applying transient routing + throttle:
```
redwoodctl tenant set --tenant meridian --throttle 5rpm --max-tokens-request 8000 --fallback model-redwood-narrow
```
Executing...

incident-bot: job started: cfg-1870004321-01 (tenant routing + throttle)

sara (eng-runtime): Changes applied:
```
[16:10:08] tenant_update OK tenant=meridian throttle=5rpm max_tokens=8000
[16:10:11] routing OK fallback=model-redwood-narrow
```

omar (customer-ops): I informed Meridian: "We've put a temporary protective mode in place while we investigate; requests will be slowed and context shortened to avoid inflated billing. We'll follow up with details and reconciliation." They replied: "Appreciate it, please advise ETA."

paul (support): Measured impact: Meridian tpm dropped from 15.6k -> 1.4k within 12 minutes. No customer-visible errors reported.

sara (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: upstream library bumped to vX.y which for certain locales started encoding text as UTF-16 with BOM. Their proxy forwards bytes as octet-stream and our VPC proxy hasn't normalized encodings. I'll prepare a normalization middleware that detects BOMs and coerces UTF-16LE/BE to UTF-8, with a fallback to best-effort decode, plus a firm reject metric for clearly-binary payloads.

noah (eng-sre): Good. Keep protections on for 48h. Also add an alert rule: if any tenant tokens/request > 10k twice in 10m -> auto-apply throttle and notify on-call. We need automation to avoid manual paging for obvious spikes.

paul (support): Meridian asked about billing. Can we offer a temporary invoice hold or credit? Finance wants a documented timeline.

finance-bot: NOTE: Billing flag created for tenant Meridian for window 1870004321 (pending review). Ticket: BILL-2407.

rachel (sales-ent): Meridian is enterprise; please CC billing/legal. I'll schedule a touch-base if they ask for escalation. We should prepare a short one-paragraph explanation for them.

paul (support): Here's a short customer-facing line: "We detected a character-encoding mismatch causing inflated token counts. We've applied temporary safeguards and will reconcile billing for the affected period." Omar, can you send with time stamps?

omar (customer-ops): Will send; please confirm exact times. Noah, can you paste mitigation timeline?

noah (eng-sre): Timeline (UTC):
- 16:02:43: first anomalous request observed
- 16:06:30: incident-bot alert fired
- 16:10:08: protective throttle + fallback model applied
- 16:22:00: token rates returned to baseline

paul (support): Customer replied: "Thanks, please apply credits." Omar, submit to finance with timeline.

omar (customer-ops): Submitting now.

sara (eng-runtime): Technical follow-ups: I'm opening PR for ingress normalization (detect BOMs, coerce UTF-16BE/LE to UTF-8, strip control chars) and adding a telemetry flag non_utf8_detected. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/vpc-proxy/pulls/4210 (WIP). Also adding unit tests with UTF-16LE/BE samples and surrogate pairs.

sara (eng-runtime): Quick hotpatch possibility: inject a middleware that inspects first 4 bytes for BOM and rewrites body to UTF-8 inline. I can produce a minimal patch and run a canary within ~6 hours. That avoids a full revert but needs careful testing.

noah (eng-sre): Keep current protections until post-deploy verification. Also add a dashboard: top offending tenants by median tokens/request and count of non_utf8_detected flags.

paul (support): Postmortem note: recommend adding an onboarding checklist item: clients must exercise the encoding check with test vectors. Also include a sample script to validate client encoding.

rachel (sales-ent): I'll draft the customer email and include cc to billing/legal. Omar please send draft and I'll review.

noah (eng-sre): Handoff: I'm off in 30m. Sara, you're on-call for follow-ups and PR. Omar will handle customer comms and finance ticket. If anything reverts, page me.

sara (eng-runtime): Taking ownership. I'll land PR, run canary, and post results. Action items:
- Merge PR 4210: ingress normalization + telemetry
- Add auto-throttle rule for extreme token spikes
- Billing: BILL-2407 needs reconciliation before invoice close
- Docs: update VPC onboarding with encoding test vectors

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity set P2. Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Ticket: INC-1870004321.

finance-bot: Billing ticket BILL-2407 updated: provisional credit approved pending RCA.

omar (customer-ops): Customer acknowledged email and accepted provisional credit. Closing loop on the call.

paul (support): Adding to postmortems board.

sara (eng-runtime): I'll post PR link + canary results once done. Thanks all.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: 1870004321. Duration: ~60m. Final status: mitigated, monitoring. Actions assigned to sara, omar, paul.
